prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Split Layout Redesign: Redesign the Story screen using a split layout to present mascot backstory alongside onboarding options.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "split"}}
1: [choose_path, new_screen] New Path Selection Overview Screen: Add a new path introduction screen before path selection that highlights available pet companion styles.
   config: {"_order": ["new_path_intro", "story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_path_intro": {"headline": "Choose Your Companion Journey", "body": "Explore different ways to create and interact with your new desktop pet.", "layout": "centered", "button_label": "Continue"}}
2: [adoption, new_screen] New Pet Personality Intro Screen: Introduce a companion personality preview screen right before picking a friend to give context on pet behaviors.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "new_pet_personality_intro", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_pet_personality_intro": {"headline": "Meet Companion Personalities", "body": "Each pet brings unique behaviors and playful desktop interactions.", "layout": "card", "button_label": "Pick Your Pet"}}
3: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Carousel Layout Redesign: Rebuild the Pick Friend screen using a carousel layout for browsing available companions smoothly.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "carousel"}}
4: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Re-login Account Sync Reminder Hint: Add an explicit hint on the sign-in screen reminding returning users to sign in with their original account to preserve pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Sign in with your primary account to preserve and sync existing desktop pets."}}
5: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Background System Readiness Note: Display a system background processing hint on the waiting screen reassuring users while their companion initializes.
   config: {"waiting": {"hint": "Your desktop companion is compiling in the background. Keep this app open while setup finishes."}}
6: [finish, notification] Home Intro Desktop Pet Activation Prompt: Enable a desktop activation notification prompt on the home intro screen to confirm pet spawning.
   config: {"home_intro": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "Click launch to spawn your companion directly onto your desktop screen."}}
7: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Screen Spotlight Layout Redesign: Redesign the home intro completion screen using a spotlight layout to highlight final launch controls.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "spotlight"}}
8: [adoption, copy] Upload Photos Quality Requirement Clarification: Update the headline and body copy on the photo upload screen with clear lighting and framing instructions.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"headline": "Upload Clear, Well-Lit Photos", "body": "Ensure your photo is well-lit and front-facing for the best custom pet rendering results."}}
9: [finish, new_screen] New Desktop Companion Interaction Guide Screen: Add an interaction guide screen before finish explaining how to summon, minimize, and talk to your pet on the desktop.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_desktop_interaction_guide", "home_intro"], "new_desktop_interaction_guide": {"headline": "How to Interact with Your Pet", "body": "Use desktop controls to hide or reveal your pet, and click your pet anytime to start talking.", "layout": "checklist", "button_label": "Got It!"}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning the story screen layout is an allowed change within onboarding.
Adding a new introductory screen while preserving all required onboarding steps is permitted.
Adding a pet personality preview screen before pick_friend retains all required steps and fulfills rule requirements.
Redesigning pick_friend to a carousel layout maintains its functionality and is allowed.
Adding a sign-in hint for returning users is helpful and complies with all rules.
Adding background processing information to the waiting screen complies with all rules.
Enabling a desktop activation prompt on the home intro screen is allowed inside onboarding.
Redesigning the home intro screen layout is allowed inside onboarding.
Updating photo upload instructions with clear requirements is permitted.
Adding a desktop interaction guide screen before home intro retains all required onboarding steps and is allowed.
